pages.title: Matrix dimensions and multiplication
pages.summary: A is 3×1 and B is 3×3, so AB is undefined; BA is recorded as (−1,8,−1). Begins a matrix inverse by augmentation.

pages.title: Inverse by row operations
pages.summary: Continuation of the augmented matrix reduction to an inverse.

pages.title: Solving using an inverse
pages.summary: Two systems solved using a supplied inverse; recorded answers (8,−1,−8) and (13,−2,−13). These full systems are not independently certified here.

pages.title: Partial fractions
pages.summary: Factoring x³+2x²−3x and solving for coefficients. Review note: the correct decomposition is 1/x + 1/(x−1) − 2/(x+3).

pages.title: Linear inequalities

pages.title: Parabola from an equation

title: Homework 6 · Conics & sequences
summary: Ellipse and string construction. Hyperbola. Completing the square. Rotated conic. Recursive sequence. Arithmetic sequence.

pages.title: Ellipse and string construction
pages.summary: The centerpiece: recorded semiaxes a=4 ft, b=2 ft give c=√12 ft and a two-focus string length of 8 ft.

pages.title: Hyperbola
pages.summary: 9x²−4y²=36: center (0,0), vertices (±2,0), foci (±√13,0), asymptotes y=±3x/2.

pages.title: Rotated conic
pages.summary: 13x²+6√3xy+7y²=16. The recorded 30° substitution is appropriate, but its final denominators need correction to X²+Y²/4=1.

pages.title: Arithmetic sequence
pages.summary: 11,8,5,2,… has difference −3; aₙ=11−3(n−1), a₅=−1 and a₁₀₀=−286. The final line labels the term formula as a difference; the difference itself is −3.
